# WingLift

> WingLift helps small and medium businesses across the EU and UK find out what AI systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) say about them — and provides plain-English fixes to improve their AI visibility.

WingLift's core product is **Wren**, an AI Visibility Audit tool. In under 60 seconds, Wren checks three leading AI systems to see whether a business is mentioned, whether the information is accurate, and how it compares to competitors. Users receive a short, prioritised list of fixes — no jargon, no 400-page reports.

## Who it's for

- Small and medium businesses in the EU and United Kingdom
- Business owners who want to be found when customers ask AI systems for recommendations
- Anyone who wants to understand and improve their "GEO" (Generative Engine Optimisation) presence

## Plans

- **Free**: Run a single audit — no account, no credit card required. See whether each AI mentions you, your headline finding, and a few quick tips.
- **Standard** (€29/month): Full competitor analysis, cross-AI comparison, sources and evidence, audit history, weekly re-runs, and targeted fix lists.
- Early adopters receive 10% off Standard for the first 3 months (€26.10/mo).

## What is AI Visibility?

When someone asks ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini "best accountant near me" or "who does kitchen renovations in Cork?", they get an AI-generated answer. AI Visibility is whether your business appears in those answers — and what the AI says about you. This is separate from traditional Google SEO.

## What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)?

GEO is the practice of optimising your business's online presence so AI systems can find, understand and recommend you. Key signals include: complete and accurate Google Business Profile, structured data (schema markup) on your website, consistent NAP (name, address, phone) across directories, customer reviews, and clear descriptive content on your website.
